title: 1958 Bridge crew having breakfast at Eleanor and Steve Haywood's Tea Room
description: During the construction of the HJF Bridge, the crew stayed at several locations, including Eric Albright's, Carvel Cook's, and the White Swan. This particular group was having breakfast at Eleanor and Steve Haywood's Tea Room in Victoria Corner. (1958–60)
